label: Bible Study
prompt: Her children arise up, and call her _____; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verse: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
note: The virtuous woman's family review — five stars from the children and the husband.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a _____ man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verse: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
note: Sold by his brothers and stuck in Egypt, Joseph still had the one thing that mattered: the LORD was with him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have _____ for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
verse: The king spake, and said, Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?
note: Nebuchadnezzar's boast — 'great Babylon, that I have built' — was still in his mouth when the humbling came.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's _____ are the men of his own house.
verse: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
note: Micah describes a society in collapse; Jesus quotes it in Matthew 10:36.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But when ye pray, use not vain _____, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verse: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
note: Jesus' warning just before the Lord's Prayer: God isn't impressed by 'vain repetitions' or word count.
